findings: Primary incorrectly treats the vulnerable i40iw predecessor as irrelevant because it lacks the later total_cnt equality check. The predecessor has the same security effect and source-to-sink path: after b6a529da69ce removes the actual page-count guard, an oversized umem reaches the fixed pgaddrmem[4] no-PBLE destination and the copier advances past it.

The authoritative CVE record is PUBLISHED and its listed git range starts at b48c24c2d710/v5.14, but clone history proves the same mechanism existed in the same Linux driver lineage from b6a529da69ce/v4.10; the affected-release evidence in primary is therefore incomplete.
The direct-fix and BIC-only AI conclusions survive the correction: 5ebb3ed757be is the direct mainline closure for the surviving irdma path, and the corrected 2016 BIC has no AI marker.

corrected_fields.flaw_origin: The flaw was first introduced by b6a529da69ce880ee4d0f3730ef46ead7f7cd0d3 in i40iw. That commit removed the explicit rejection of no-PBLE registrations whose actual page_cnt exceeded MAX_SAVE_PAGE_ADDRS (4), while i40iw_copy_user_pgaddrs still wrote every mapped page and QP/CQ use_pbles remained derived from separate request page-count fields. The immediate parent d4165e3abdf16707602c10f0d678d4d564a87e35 contains the guard. The later irdma replacement series copied this mechanism into b48c24c2d710 and added an equality check that is ineffective when total_cnt is zero.
corrected_fields.ai_marker: absent; corrected BIC author Henry Orosco <henry.orosco@intel.com>, committer Doug Ledford <dledford@redhat.com>; commit object contains Signed-off-by trailers for Shiraz Saleem, Henry Orosco, and Doug Ledford, with no Co-Authored-By, Generated-by/with, Assisted-by, bot, or model identity
evidence: git show b6a529da69ce^:drivers/infiniband/hw/i40iw/i40iw_verbs.c shows if (!use_pbles && (iwmr->page_cnt > MAX_SAVE_PAGE_ADDRS)) return -ENOMEM immediately before i40iw_setup_pbles chooses pgaddrmem; the b6a529da69ce diff deletes exactly that guard.

At b6a529da69ce, i40iw_copy_user_pgaddrs iterates all mapped pages and advances pbl without a destination-length bound; i40iw_reg_user_mr derives QP/CQ use_pbles from req.sq_pages/req.rq_pages/req.cq_pages rather than the actual mapped page count, while i40iw_mr.pgaddrmem has four entries.

git log -S for the deleted guard shows its addition in d37498417947 and removal in b6a529da69ce, with no restoration before the replacement. Copy detection maps i40iw/i40iw_verbs.c to irdma/verbs.c at 20%, and fa0cf568fd765 identifies irdma as the replacement driver.

merge-base ancestry: corrected BIC is absent from v4.9 and present in v4.10-rc1/v4.10. Stable fix ancestry is absent/present across v5.15.211/212, v6.1.177/178, v6.6.144/145, v6.12.96/97, v6.18.39/40, and v7.1.4/5; mainline fix is absent from v7.1 and present in v7.2.

CVE.org API reports CVE-2026-74390 state PUBLISHED, and GitHub advisory GHSA-c23v-2w7h-h6m9 has withdrawn_at=null. Their published affected range begins at b48c24c2d710/v5.14, which does not account for the earlier i40iw lineage established by repository history.
corrected_fields.reasoning: The security invariant is the capacity of the inline destination, not the spelling of the later failed equality check. The parent of b6a529da69ce rejects every no-PBLE registration whose actual mapped page count exceeds the four-entry array. b6a529da69ce removes that invariant while preserving an unbounded source walk and request-derived QP/CQ no-PBLE selection, so it is the first atomic commit whose parent is safe and whose tree admits this out-of-bounds write. b48c24c2d710 later ports the vulnerable lineage into replacement driver irdma and cannot be the BIC under the protocol's move/refactor exclusion. The corrected BIC predates v4.10 and has no AI marker, so the final authorship verdict remains NOT_AI, but the introducer and affected-release evidence require correction.
